worker_task_pool_contract.idle_retire: idle(slot): idleMs = options.idleTimeoutMs ?? 6e4; if idleMs > 0 a timer retires the slot after idleMs (unref)
worker_task_pool_contract.pressure_retire: createWorker: if (options.idleTimeoutMs ?? 6e4) > 0 the pool subscribes retireIdleOnPressure to channel openclaw.memory.critical

turn_gateway_prep_seconds.definition: Gateway 'res agent' accepted -> lifecycle phase=start, same session, from the Gateway log

worker_spawns_one_turn.method: inspector NodeWorker.attachedToWorker during one owner turn, ms after the CLI spawn (CLI boot ~2.5 s before the request)

privacy: Timings, thread counts and public module hashes only; no transcript, prompt, config, token or account data.

handle_module.contract: SQLITE_IDLE_HANDLE_TTL_MS = 18e5 is the one idle window shared by every SQLite owner (agent db lifecycle, read-only scopes, state cache, state read worker pool, reclamation and transcript workers)

settled_bench_after_30min_keepalive.definition: 5 owner turns in one new session, 90 s apart, Gateway up > 1 h, previous turn > 30 min earlier; total = 'res agent' -> phase=start, catalog = tool catalogue -> phase=start
settled_bench_after_30min_keepalive.reading: turns 2-5 are warm; the first turn after > 30 min pays both 30 min windows: the agent database handle was closed, its reopen queued an integrity quick_check while the session write waited 2.6 s, and the recall worker respawned (catalog -> start 3.2 s)
